transcript: Khatoon, 26 saal. 2 din se peshab mein jalan hai. HB 12. HB 12. Bukhar nahi. Kamarival nahi. Plaquenil nahi hai. Sipro 500 din mein do baar, 3 din. Paani zyada piyein. Peshab ko. Tast karwa lein. 3 din mein farq na pare to dupar aana hai.

medications.name: Ciprofloxacin
medications.instructions: drink plenty of water, void urine

advice: Return if no improvement in 3 days
